units: <cite ref="Mishnah Maasrot 4:2">Maasr. IV, 2</cite> <he>ושכחו לעַשְּׂרָן</he> but had forgotten to pay the tithe of them.

<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 2:7">Sabb. II, 7</cite> <he>עִשַּׂרְתֶּם</he> have you set aside tithes (of what you intend to use for the Sabbath)? <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 2:7">Ib.</cite> <he>ספק … אין מְעַשְּׂרִין את הודאי</he> if it is doubtful whether or not night has set in, you must not separate the tithes of what is sure to be subject to tithes (v. <cite ref="D00871"><he>דְּמַאי</he></cite>); a. v. fr.—Part. pass. <he>מְעוּשָּׂר</he>; f. <he>מְעוּשֶּׂרֶת</he>; pl. <he>מְעוּשָּׂרִים</he>, <he>מְעוּשָּׂרִין</he>; <he>מְעוּשָּׂרוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bekhorot 9:7">Bekh. IX, 7</cite> (<he>קפץ אחד</he>) <he>מן המע׳ לתוכן</he> if one of those (lambs) which have been set aside as tithe, leaped among the flock.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bekhorot 9:7">Ib.</cite> <he>הרי אלו מע׳</he> they (the flock) are considered as tithed; a. fr.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 7:11">Cant. R. to VII, 11</cite>, v. <cite ref="P01498"><he>עָשַׁר</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: , Nithpa. נִתְעַשֵּׂר to be tithed. Maasr. l. c. עד שיֵעָשְׂרוּ (Ms. M. שיִתְעַשְּׂרוּ) until they are tithed. Ib. 5 מִתְעַשֶּׂרֶת זרע וכ׳ must be tithed as seed, as vegetables (if the leaves are used) &c.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bekhorot 9:1">Bekh. IX, 1</cite> <he>ואינן מִתְעַשְּׂרִים מזה על זה</he> and they (large cattle and small cattle) cannot be tithed one for the other.
<cite ref="Bekhorot 53b:16">Ib. 53ᵇ</cite> <he>אין דין שיִתְעַשְּׂרוּ זה מזה</he> should we not conclude that they may be tithed one for the other?; a. fr.
